[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Eduard was born in 1609. He is the son of [[Glasgow-991|James Glasgow]]. 

Mother is listed as Christina Bie on ancestry (1568-1636)<ref>https://www.ancestry.co.uk/genealogy/records/eduard-glasgow-24-tst8k4?geo_a=r&o_iid=41013&o_lid=41013&o_sch=Web+Property</ref>

Edward was born before 1609. He is the son of [[Glasgow-991|James Glasgow]] and [[Adamson-3318|Christina Adamson]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-991]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The 27 February 1609 Inveresk child record names James Glasgow as Eduard’s father. The exact Inveresk event matches Eduard’s child account and the selected James’s recurring parish family.

Confident for the recorded child and father, without choosing a later adult Edward identity or inventing a mother.

Next useful test: Compare later Edward evidence against the exact parish event.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-994 James Glasgow in entry for Eduard Glasgow (27 Feb 1609), "Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950"]; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686174177&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Eduard Glasgow, 1609, record R_686174177]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


=== Fisherrow property identity ===

The Eduard Glasgow indexed as James’s child in Inveresk in 1609 is a compatible adult for the Edward associated with [[Glasgow-1148|Alexander Glasgow]] in the14 February1646 Fisherrow sasine index. He is the preferred identity at43% subjective probability. [[Glasgow-1558|Edward indexed in1615]] and [[Glasgow-1557|the older Inveresk father Edward]] remain alternatives. The1624 Edward occurrence is separately preferred as the older Edward1557 at56%; the22-year interval does not prove identity or inheritance. These are record-specific identity hypotheses, not new parent statements.<ref>Scottish Record Office, Indexes44, Edinburgh etc. register of sasines1644–1653, printed pp159–160, [https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=mdp.39015072481222&seq=167 digital index], 33/258,14 February1646. Printed-index reading reused; original instrument not inspected.</ref>
